boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain New York University
boards.description: Ten food-focused, under-21-safe destinations around NYU’s Washington Square campus with currently posted late or overnight availability.

cards.title: Mamoun's Falafel
cards.subtitle: 119 MacDougal Street, near Washington Square
cards.notes: Check the day before heading out: the Greenwich Village shop posts takeout from open to close, with later closing on several nights.
cards.short_summary: A MacDougal Street counter with posted hours reaching 1–4 a.m., depending on the day.
cards.evidence_claim: Mamoun's official Greenwich Village page lists 119 MacDougal Street and hours through 2 a.m. Monday–Wednesday, 3 a.m. Thursday, and 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Mamoun's Falafel — Greenwich Village Hours + Location
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: Mon–Wed until 2 a.m.; Thu until 3 a.m.; Fri–Sat until 4 a.m.; Sun until 1 a.m. Takeout is listed from open to close.

cards.title: Artichoke Basille's Pizza
cards.subtitle: 111 MacDougal Street, near Washington Square
cards.notes: Use the official location page to match your night: its closing time varies substantially between early week and the weekend.
cards.short_summary: A MacDougal pizza stop with official closing times as late as 4 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Artichoke Basille's official Greenwich Village page lists 111 MacDougal Street and closing times of midnight, 2 a.m., or 4 a.m. by day.
cards.source_title: Artichoke Basille's Pizza — Greenwich Village Hours + Location
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: Sun–Mon until midnight; Tue–Wed until 2 a.m.; Thu–Sat until 4 a.m.

cards.title: 7th Street Burger
cards.subtitle: 110 MacDougal Street, near Washington Square
cards.notes: Plan around the day-specific close, and use the restaurant’s order or directions links if you need a quick pickup route.
cards.short_summary: A made-to-order burger counter on MacDougal with late posted hours every day.
cards.evidence_claim: 7th Street Burger's official West Village page lists 110 MacDougal Street and hours until 1 a.m. most nights and 3 a.m. Friday–Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours extend to 1 a.m. Monday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Sunday.

cards.title: Thelewala
cards.subtitle: 112 MacDougal Street, near Washington Square
cards.notes: Confirm the weekday before going; the official site posts a midnight close on some nights and later hours Tuesday through Saturday.
cards.short_summary: An Indian street-food counter on MacDougal with published late-week hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Thelewala's official site lists 112 MacDougal Street and hours until 2 a.m. Tuesday–Thursday and 4 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: Sun–Mon until midnight; Tue–Thu until 2 a.m.; Fri–Sat until 4 a.m.

cards.title: Caffè Reggio
cards.subtitle: MacDougal Street, near Washington Square
cards.notes: Settle in for coffee, tea, or a dessert after dinner; the café’s official menu labels its dinner service as running through 3 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A historic Greenwich Village café whose official menu posts dinner until 3 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Caffè Reggio's official menu states that its dinner menu is served from 4 p.m. to 3 a.m.
cards.access_notes: The official menu labels dinner service as 4 p.m.–3 a.m.; verify availability directly before a visit.

cards.title: Bleecker Street Pizza
cards.subtitle: 69 7th Avenue South, near Washington Square
cards.notes: Use the posted day-by-day schedule before leaving: this shop has a midnight close early in the week and much later weekend hours.
cards.short_summary: A 7th Avenue South pizzeria with posted closing times through 5 a.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Bleecker Street Pizza's official contact page lists 69 7th Avenue South and hours through midnight Sunday–Wednesday, 4 a.m. Thursday, and 5 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Posted hours: Sun–Wed until midnight; Thu until 4 a.m.; Fri–Sat until 5 a.m.

cards.title: The Donut Pub
cards.subtitle: 203 West 14th Street at 7th Avenue
cards.notes: Head to the West Village storefront when you need an overnight option; the official location page explicitly says it is open 24 hours.
cards.short_summary: A doughnut-and-coffee stop with officially posted 24-hour availability.
cards.evidence_claim: The Donut Pub's official West Village page lists 203 West 14th Street and states that the location is open 24 hours.
cards.source_title: The Donut Pub — West Village Hours + Location

cards.title: Coppelia
cards.subtitle: 207 West 14th Street, near Greenwich Village
cards.notes: Use the diner’s official contact page for the address and current overnight availability, then choose from its food and nonalcoholic menu options.
cards.short_summary: A Latin diner on West 14th Street that officially posts 24-hour operation.
cards.evidence_claim: Coppelia's official contact page lists 207 West 14th Street and says the restaurant is open 24 hours.

cards.title: Veselka
cards.subtitle: 144 Second Avenue, East Village
cards.notes: Check the day-specific schedule and choose dine-in or takeout; weekend service rolls into overnight and the official site lists indoor and outdoor dining.
cards.short_summary: An East Village Ukrainian restaurant with posted overnight weekend availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Veselka's official locations page lists 144 Second Avenue and posts East Village hours until midnight Monday–Thursday, then overnight Friday–Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Posted East Village hours: Mon–Thu until midnight; Friday open overnight; Saturday open 24 hours; Sunday closes at 11 p.m.

cards.title: GUSI
cards.subtitle: 432 Sixth Avenue, Greenwich Village
cards.notes: For a later sit-down meal near Washington Square, reserve or check in directly; the restaurant’s own page lists nightly service through midnight.
cards.short_summary: A Greenwich Village restaurant two blocks from West 4th Street with midnight posted hours.
cards.evidence_claim: GUSI's official site lists 432 Sixth Avenue, describes it as a short walk from NYU and Washington Square Park, and posts hours until midnight daily.
cards.access_notes: Official site posts service until midnight Monday–Friday and Saturday–Sunday.
